readOnly.cloudSynced: This folder is copied to other computers by a cloud service. Two computers saving into one project folder can lose work. Copy the project to a folder that is not synced?

readOnly.folderNotWritable: This project's folder cannot be written to now (the disk may be full). Nothing you saved is lost. Free some space, then open the project again.
readOnly.needsNewerApp: This project needs a newer version of translationCore to save changes. You can read and export it.
readOnly.openOnAnotherComputer: This project may be open on another computer. Copy the project to work on it here, or, if that computer is closed, say so and open it again.

readOnly.unsafeDrive: This drive cannot keep the project safe if the power fails. Copy the project to this computer?

refusal.open.newer-format: This project was saved by a newer translationCore (project format {format}). Update translationCore, then open the project again. Nothing was changed.
